Description: Increases your character's riding speed by 1 per lesson. Riding Speed allows you to move faster while mounted and takes effect on your character regardless of the mount you have set active. Your current Riding Speed is 0/60.

Increases your riding stamina by 1 per lesson. Riding Stamina helps prevent being dismounted, allows your mount to sprint longer, and takes effect on your character regardless of the mount set active. Your current Riding Stamina is 0/60.

Expands your character's inventory by 1 slot per lesson. Riding Capacity allows you to carry more items and takes effect on your character regardless of the mount you have set active. Your character's current Riding Capacity is 0/60.
